hooks.command: echo 'Checking if documentation needs updates...'; if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx|json|md)$' > /dev/null; then echo '📝 Code changes detected - updating documentation...'; claude /update-docs --no-session-persistence 2>/dev/null || echo '📋 Run /update-docs to refresh documentation'; fi
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -E '\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$' > /dev/null; then echo "📝 Code file updated: $(basename "$f")"; fi; }
